units.source_text: 内侍与头中将的私情非常秘密，源氏公子不得而知。

en.t: The Naishi's affair with the Captain was kept deeply secret, and Prince Genji knew nothing of it.

units.source_text: 内侍每逢与公子相会，必先申恨诉怨。

en.t: Whenever the Naishi met with the prince, she would first pour out her grievances and complaints.

units.source_text: 源氏公子念她年老，很是可怜，颇想加以慰藉，

en.t: Prince Genji thought of her old age and felt very sorry for her, and he rather wished to comfort her,

units.source_text: 然而又不高兴这样做，所以很久不理睬她。

en.t: but he was also unwilling to do so, and therefore ignored her for a long time.

units.source_text: 有一天，傍晚下了一阵雨，雨后新凉宜人。

en.t: One day, a shower fell in the evening, and the fresh coolness after the rain was pleasant.

units.source_text: 源氏公子欲消遣这良宵，在内侍所居的温明殿近旁徘徊闲步。

en.t: Prince Genji, wishing to pass this fine evening, wandered idly near the Onmeiden where the Naishi lived.

units.source_text: 内侍正在弹琵琶，声音非常悦耳。

en.t: The Naishi was playing the biwa, and its sound was exceedingly pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 原来这内侍每逢御前管弦演奏等机会，常常参与男人队伍内弹琵琶，

en.t: As it happened, whenever there were court music performances before the emperor and similar occasions, this Naishi often joined the men's ranks and played the biwa,

units.source_text: 故于此道十分擅长，人莫能及。

en.t: and so she was extremely skilled in this art, with no one able to equal her.

units.source_text: 加之此时满怀离情别绪，无处发泄，所以弹得更加动听。

en.t: Moreover, at this moment her heart was full of the sorrow of parting with nowhere to release it, so her playing sounded all the more moving.

units.source_text: 她正在唱催马乐《山城》之歌：“……好个种瓜郎，要我做妻房。

en.t: She was singing the saibara song Yamashiro: "...A fine melon-growing lad wants me for his wife.

units.source_text: ……想来又想去，嫁与也何妨……”嗓音非常美妙，然而略觉不大相称。

en.t: ...Thinking it over again and again, what harm would there be in marrying him?..." Her voice was very beautiful, yet it seemed somewhat inappropriate.

units.source_text: 源氏公子倾耳而听，想道：“从前白居易在鄂州听到那个人的歌声[\[17\]](#part1336.html#m17)，想必也有这般美妙吧。”

en.t: Prince Genji listened intently and thought, "Long ago, when Bai Juyi heard that person's singing in Ezhou[\[17\]](#part1336.html#m17), it must have been as beautiful as this."
